full_text_en:
Bao Guorong — Dereliction of Duty Case

Defendant: Bao Guorong, male, 45 years old, former Secretary of the Party General Branch and Administrative Head of Yilin Forest Farm in Mohe County, Heilongjiang Province. Arrested on July 3, 1987.

The Daxing'anling Branch of Heilongjiang Provincial People's Procuratorate initiated a public prosecution against the defendant Bao Guorong for the crime of dereliction of duty before the Daxing'anling Prefecture Intermediate People's Court. After accepting the case, the court formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law and held a public hearing on June 15, 1988, and found the following facts:

On May 6, 1987, when forest fires broke out in the jurisdiction areas of Amuer Forestry Bureau and Xilinji Forestry Bureau, the defendant Bao Guorong was responsible for the overall fire prevention duty at the forest farm. At approximately 9:50 p.m. on the 7th, Bao Guorong said to the duty dispatcher: "I'm going home. If something comes up, come find me." Thereafter, Bao Guorong left the duty office and went home. At approximately 1:00 a.m. on the 8th, after receiving a fire alarm from the duty personnel, Bao Guorong went to the broadcasting room of the forest farm, notified all staff and their family members to gather at the square, and instructed the driver to move the vehicle to a safe place. However, after leaving the broadcasting room, Bao Guorong did not go to the square to organize the evacuation of the crowd. Instead, he went with his wife, son, and others to the roadside west of the forest farm to take shelter from the fire. Since no one was in charge, the crowd that had gathered at the square was in chaos. When the forest farm driver passed by in the vehicle, Bao Guorong, disregarding the safety of the staff and their families, climbed into the vehicle with his wife, son, and four other workers, totaling six people, and ordered the driver to drive to a location under the "No. 38" Bridge, 2 kilometers away from the forest farm, to take shelter. At that time, it was approximately 1:15 a.m. on the 8th, and the fire had not yet reached the forest farm.

At approximately 3:30 a.m. that day, after the main fire front had passed through the forest farm, Bao Guorong returned to the forest farm by vehicle. At that time, embers were still burning, and eight staff family houses had not yet been burned. Bao Guorong still did not organize the crowd to fight the fire and carry out rescue operations. Instead, he asked people to help move his own belongings, resulting in the destruction of five staff family houses that could have been saved by the spreading embers, causing direct economic losses of over RMB 190,000. Because Bao Guorong fled from the forest farm and abandoned his leadership, Yilin Forest Farm suffered three deaths and economic losses of over RMB 2,121,300 in this fire.

The above facts are clear, and the evidence is truthful and sufficient.

The Daxing'anling Prefecture Intermediate People's Court held in its trial that: The "Spring Forest Fire Prevention Order" issued by the Heilongjiang Provincial People's Government on April 21, 1987 stipulates: "From this date onward, leading cadres responsible for forest fire prevention in all areas shall immediately assume their posts, deploy and command fire prevention work." In the event of a fire, "local leaders shall personally go to the scene to direct, organize manpower and materials, promptly extinguish the fire, and ensure the safety of state property and personal safety." However, during the fire prevention duty period, the defendant Bao Guorong left his post without authorization; after receiving the fire alarm, disregarding the safety of the masses, he fled by vehicle; after returning to the forest farm, he again failed to organize the masses to extinguish the fire and carry out rescue operations, resulting in significant losses to Yilin Forest Farm and the life and property of the masses. He shall bear direct leadership responsibility for this. The above conduct of Bao Guorong has constituted the crime of dereliction of duty as stipulated in Article 187 of the Criminal Law of the PRC. Accordingly, on June 16, 1988, the court sentenced the defendant Bao Guorong to three years of fixed-term imprisonment for the crime of dereliction of duty.

Bao Guorong refused to accept the first-instance judgment and appealed to the Heilongjiang High People's Court on the grounds that "leaving the post to go home during the duty period was normal rest after overwork and did not violate the Spring Forest Fire Prevention Order; the first instance finding that I fled when the fire came and did not actively organize the masses to extinguish the fire and carry out rescue operations is inconsistent with the facts."

The Heilongjiang High People's Court held at the second instance that: Under the circumstances where a forest fire had occurred in an adjacent forest farm, the appellant Bao Guorong actually left his post without authorization and went home; when the forest fire approached, disregarding the interests of the state and the people, he fled with his wife and son to a safe area; after returning to the forest farm, he not only failed to organize the masses to fight the fire, but actually asked people to rescue his own household property. His conduct clearly violated the requirements of the provincial government's "Spring Forest Fire Prevention Order." Therefore, Bao Guorong bears an unshirkable direct leadership responsibility for the significant losses suffered by Yilin Forest Farm in the forest fire. The facts that Bao Guorong fled from the scene and did not actively organize workers to fight the fire and carry out rescue operations have been confirmed by multiple workers of the forest farm and are sufficient to establish. The appellant Bao Guorong's grounds of appeal cannot be sustained. The original judgment was not improper. In accordance with Item (1) of Article 136 of the Criminal Procedure Law of the PRC, the court rendered a ruling on August 26, 1988, dismissing Bao Guorong's appeal and affirming the original judgment.
